Load the pinned source files into the ledger

Source: R/md-ledger-build.R
md_build_ledger.Rd

Walks the sources that write names or addresses, finds each one's pinned files under sources/<source>/<version>/, parses each with its md_parse_*() function and applies it with md_apply_release(): one release per file, so a year-partitioned source is one partition per year. Each file's md5 comes from the pin's FILES.csv when there is one, so a file already applied is skipped on the next run.

Usage

md_build_ledger(con, versions, sources = NULL)

Arguments

con

A DuckDB connection.

versions

A named list of versions, as in dev/build-versions.R.

sources

Restrict to these sources. Default: every source above.

Value

A data frame, one row per release, from md_apply_release().

Details

sourceversion keyfiles
bmf_unifiedbmf_unifiedthe pinned parquet
efile_header, schedi, efile_related, efile_affiliate_listingefilethe published table, one <TABLE>-YYYY.CSV per tax year
f1023ezf1023ezf1023ez-approvals-YYYY.csv, the CSVs md_ingest_f1023ez() converts the workbooks to
e_postcarde_postcard*-E-POSTCARD.csv
revocationsrevocations*-REVOCATIONS-ORGS.csv
address_crosswalkaddress_crosswalkthe pinned CSV
bmf_activebmf_activethe pinned CSV, only if a version is given

A source whose version is missing from versions, or whose files are not there, is skipped with a message rather than failing the run.
